cover.subject: full-figure
cover.headline: Your easy pace is not slow enough.

notes: three short lines at 140 hold up
a long reach to the shoe, pointing at the words

slides.label: 01 · EASY MEANS EASY
slides.headline: That is roughly what easy feels like at first: too slow.

source.quote: Easy (E) pace versus 5K race pace, VDOT 30 to 60 rows of the training-intensity table

slides.headline: If you cannot talk in full sentences, slow down.

slides.label: 03 · WALK BREAKS
slides.headline: Walk breaks are not failure.
slides.body: Run-walk is how most people reach thirty continuous minutes. Nobody is checking.

slides.label: 04 · BEFORE YOU ADD DISTANCE
slides.headline: Three weeks at the same volume first.
items: Same weekly distance, three weeks running
No niggle that outlasts the warm-up
Sleeping and eating like it matters

slides.label: 05 · THE TEN PERCENT RULE
slides.headline: Add about ten percent a week, at most.

source.quote: graded training programme increasing running time by 10% a week
source.publisher: Buist et al., American Journal of Sports Medicine, 2008
